expectations.text: Raster line is in the range $30 to $F7 (48 to 247)
The low 3 bits of the raster line equal YSCROLL (RASTER & 7 == YSCROLL, the low 3 bits of $D011)
expectations.evidence: States '(RASTER & 7) == YSCROLL (low 3 bits of raster equal YSCROLL)' and 'YSCROLL = $D011 low 3 bits'

expectations.text: The DEN (display enable) bit was set at some point in raster line $30
expectations.evidence: States 'DEN bit was set at some point during raster line $30 (48)'

expectations.text: Describes that on a bad line the VIC stalls the CPU to do the c-accesses (badline steals cycles)
expectations.evidence: States 'VIC asserts BA low, steals cycles 12–54 from CPU ... to fetch video matrix + color data (c-access). CPU halted those cycles.'
